entities.description: a middle-aged street-food chef with a shaved head, a black headband and a white apron

entities.name: boy
entities.description: a teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron

sentences: Wide shot at dusk of a crowded night market street, a small noodle stall with a striped orange awning and paper lanterns glowing among other stalls.

A middle-aged street-food chef with a shaved head, a black headband and a white apron lifts the striped orange awning of a small noodle stall with a striped orange awning and paper lanterns and hangs the paper lanterns.
A teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron arrives on a bicycle with crates of vegetables strapped to the back.

A middle-aged street-food chef with a shaved head, a black headband and a white apron hands a teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron a knife and points at a pile of green onions.
Close-up of hands of a teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron clumsily chopping green onions on a wooden board.

A middle-aged street-food chef with a shaved head, a black headband and a white apron laughs and shows a teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron how to hold the knife properly.
Close-up of a large wok on a roaring flame, noodles tossed high into the air.
A middle-aged street-food chef with a shaved head, a black headband and a white apron flips noodles in the wok with a single swift motion, steam rising around him.
Customers line up in front of a small noodle stall with a striped orange awning and paper lanterns, holding paper tickets.

A teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron hands a steaming bowl of noodles to a smiling old woman at a small noodle stall with a striped orange awning and paper lanterns.
Close-up of a bowl of noodles topped with a soft egg and green onions.
A sudden gust of wind blows over the paper lanterns of a small noodle stall with a striped orange awning and paper lanterns and one catches fire.
A teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron grabs a bucket of water and throws it on the burning lantern.

A middle-aged street-food chef with a shaved head, a black headband and a white apron pats a teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron on the shoulder, both of them soaked and laughing.
Rain begins to fall over the night market and people open umbrellas.

A middle-aged street-food chef with a shaved head, a black headband and a white apron and a teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron pull the striped orange awning lower as rain drums on it.

Inside a small noodle stall with a striped orange awning and paper lanterns, a teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron writes a new menu on a chalkboard in neat letters.
Close-up of the chalkboard menu reading Midnight Noodles with a drawn bowl.

A middle-aged street-food chef with a shaved head, a black headband and a white apron tastes a spoonful of broth that a teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron made, his eyebrows rising in surprise.
A teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron beams with pride, steam from the broth pot curling around him.
Late at night, the rain stops and the market street shines with reflected neon.

A middle-aged street-food chef with a shaved head, a black headband and a white apron counts coins in a tin box under a paper lantern of a small noodle stall with a striped orange awning and paper lanterns.

A middle-aged street-food chef with a shaved head, a black headband and a white apron gives a teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron a small brass key on a red string.
Close-up of the brass key resting in the palm of a teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron.

At dawn, a teenage apprentice with messy black hair, a red hoodie and a green apron alone lifts the striped orange awning of a small noodle stall with a striped orange awning and paper lanterns with the brass key around his neck.

A middle-aged street-food chef with a shaved head, a black headband and a white apron watches from across the street with a cup of tea, smiling at a small noodle stall with a striped orange awning and paper lanterns.

sentences: Wide shot of a white dome-shaped habitat on red Martian sand at sunrise, a pale blue sun rising over red hills.

Inside a white dome-shaped habitat on red Martian sand, a female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor without her helmet drinks coffee by a round window.
A female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor puts on her helmet, the gold-tinted visor sliding down.
The airlock door of a white dome-shaped habitat on red Martian sand opens and red dust swirls in.
A small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel rolls out of the airlock, its blue camera eye blinking.

A female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor walks across red Martian sand, a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel following behind her.
Close-up of boot prints of a female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor pressed into the red sand.
A female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor kneels and collects a rock sample with a small scoop.
A small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel scans the rock sample with a blue light beam.

Wide shot of a female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor and a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel climbing a rocky ridge, a white dome-shaped habitat on red Martian sand small in the distance.
A female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor looks through binoculars toward a canyon on the horizon.
A huge red dust storm appears on the horizon, rolling toward them.
A small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel spins its camera eye toward the storm and beeps urgently.

A female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor runs back down the ridge, a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel racing beside her.
Dust engulfs a female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor, her helmet light cutting through the red haze.
A small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel stalls in the sand, its wheels spinning helplessly.

A female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor turns back and lifts a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel into her arms.

A female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor trudges through the storm carrying a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel, barely visible.
The glowing airlock of a white dome-shaped habitat on red Martian sand appears through the swirling dust.

The airlock door of a white dome-shaped habitat on red Martian sand closes behind a female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor and a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel.

Inside a white dome-shaped habitat on red Martian sand, a female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor removes her helmet, breathing hard, her face streaked with sweat.

A female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor brushes red dust off the solar panel of a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel with a soft brush.
Close-up of the blue camera eye of a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel flickering back to life.

A female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor smiles and taps the top of a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel affectionately.
Night on Mars, the storm passing, two small moons visible above a white dome-shaped habitat on red Martian sand.

Inside a white dome-shaped habitat on red Martian sand, a female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor records a video log at a console with a blinking red light.
Close-up of a screen showing a photo of Earth pinned beside the console.

A small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel rolls over and nudges the leg of a female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor.

A female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor falls asleep in a chair while a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel watches beside her.

Morning, a female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor and a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel step out of a white dome-shaped habitat on red Martian sand into clear pink sky.
A female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor plants a small flag next to the rock sample site.

A small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel takes a photo of a female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor standing beside the flag.

Close-up of the photo on the screen of a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel showing a female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor waving.

Wide shot of a white dome-shaped habitat on red Martian sand, a female astronaut in a white spacesuit with orange shoulder stripes and a gold-tinted visor and a small four-wheeled rover robot with a round blue camera eye and a dusty solar panel under the calm Martian sky.

A golden retriever puppy with a red collar shakes water from its fur, spraying a small boy with short brown hair, freckles and a blue striped sweater who laughs.
